payload.short: Table 5-1 height datum: Arabic natural ground vs English finished ground
payload.text: The height datum differs between the governing Arabic Table 5-1 and its English convenience translation. Arabic note 2 measures height from natural ground level before grading and filling. English note (2) and the English column header use finished ground level after grading and filling. Under Clause 7.2 the Arabic governs. Designs and crane plans based on the English text could therefore exceed the limits wherever fill raises the ground.
